symptom: `dynamictext x (Content: '')` builds with **CE0720** "Place holder index 1 is greater than 0" — `mxcli check` ✓, describe shows `Content: '{1}'` with no params
cause: The builder unconditionally defaulted empty content to the template `{1}`, creating a placeholder with no matching parameter (orphaned)
insight: Only default to `{1}` when there IS a parameter (`autoGeneratedParams`/`explicitParams`); empty content with no params is a literal empty template. Test `TestBuildDynamicTextV3_EmptyContent`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/traceops-9-10-17-dynamictext-listview.mdl`. traceops #9
